name: sticky-notes
about: A research wall of sticky notes at the default 160x100 note size: multi-line text with explicit line breaks, bullet lists, a blank line, one very long URL, one very long single word, a note with one word, and a colour per theme, laid out in rows with right_of and below so the engine picks every position.
stresses: rows placed relative to grown neighbours

ops.text:
Onboarding
- 7 of 9 users skipped the tour
- 4 could not find the invite button
- 2 asked for SSO on day one
Pricing page is confusing: people compare the Team plan with the Business plan and cannot tell which one includes audit logs, so they open a support ticket instead of upgrading.

Quote:
"I just want to see what my team did yesterday without opening five tabs."

ops.intent: a concern with a long word

ops.text:
Next steps

1. Rewrite the tour as three short tips
2. Add an audit-log row to the pricing table
3. Fix the apostrophe export bug before the October release

Owner: research team (Dana, Luis, Mei)
Due: Friday 2026-10-02
Status: waiting on two more interviews
